info.title: FastHook Control API — Partial contract
info.description: A deliberately partial contract for stable FastHook Control API surfaces. It does not claim coverage of the complete Control API.

excluded: All Control API resources other than project-api-keys, stored Filter CRUD/test, stored Transformation CRUD/execution-history plus stateless validate/run and capabilities endpoints, Workflow CRUD/run-history/manual Step retry, and Action CRUD/status operations
CLI commands and widget runtime surfaces; synchronized artifacts do not imply owner-session feature support
The hand-authored public documentation OpenAPI document

SessionBearer.description: Dashboard session bearer token. Project API keys cannot manage project API keys.

ProjectApiKeyBearer.description: Project API key. Only operations declaring this security scheme accept it, subject to scopes and exact execute grants.

TeamId.name: x-team-id
TeamId.description: Team selected for the operation. The authenticated subject must have the role declared by the operation.

api_key.description: Returned only by createProjectApiKey. Store it immediately; it cannot be retrieved later.
